info.description: Errors use RFC 9457 problem details with a stable `code` and a `hint`. Sign in through `/v1/auth/*` (Better Auth); the website uses a cookie, the mobile app `Authorization: Bearer <session token>`. Send an `Idempotency-Key` header with a `POST` to make it safe to retry. Add `?dry_run=true` to a change to validate it without applying it.

Only import data you may use: a business's own published details, the ABR or licensed data.
